The XML Version of the TEI Guidelines

<if>

<if> defines a conditional default value for a feature; the condition is specified as a feature structure, and is met if it subsumes the feature structure in the text for which a default value is sought.
Attributes Global attributes only
Example 






Module
Declared in file teifsd2; Additional tag set for feature structures: enabled by TEI.fs





Data Description
May contain a feature structure, followed by a feature value;
the two are separated by a <then> element.




May contain
any dft f fAlt fs minus msr nbr none null plus rate str sym then uncertain vAlt 




May occur within
vDefault 




Declaration

<!ELEMENT if %om.RR; ((fs | f | fAlt), then, (%m.featureVal;) )> 
<!ATTLIST if  
      %a.global;>
